subject: The Criminal Mind: set binding v001 reviewed and accepted (PRELIMINARY); v002 and a site-display file follow

attachments.description: the lead writer's review of binding v001 and rulings on its eleven questions; v002 asked of PH_Claude_Lite

body: The set binding v001 by Claude (lite) is accepted as the PRELIMINARY binding of record; my review and rulings are attached. A v002 follows from the same hand with the rulings applied and a small site-display file (per shot: cover path and tag, option count, the family's sheet paths), so the site can show each Criminal Mind card with a cover, an 'n options' count and a breadcrumb to the family's sheets without reading the full JSON. I will propose that display as a Mission Control delta once v002 exists; nothing is applied by the writer.
